key_findings: The CGRP receptor antagonist olcegepant attenuated NTG-induced trigeminal hyperalgesia in rats and reduced CGRP, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, TRPA1 and inflammatory miRNAs in medulla-pons, cervical spinal cord and trigeminal ganglia.
Olcegepant alone did not change behaviour or inflammatory markers, arguing against central sensitization from chronic gepant use.
